summary: The ServiceProfileHistory is a feature of the HSPnet application, designed to handle and display historical data related to service profiles within the system. It involves user controls and data management for tracking actions performed on service profiles, including user details and modifications.
purpose: The purpose of ServiceProfileHistory is to provide a record of actions performed on service profiles, enabling traceability and accountability within the HSPnet system.
business_rules: Only retrieve data if UserSession is active.
Cancel data selection if UserSession is null.
Data retrieval parameters must include ServiceID and SessionAgencyID.
validations: Check if UserSession is active before allowing data retrieval.
Validate UUID format for database keys.
calculations: Format AgencyUser details with NameFormatter including initial of names.
conditions: Use alternative language fields if sess.UseAltLanguageFields is true.
Ensure ByUserSysAdmin status before formatting user details.
system_behavior: Dynamic update of UI based on user session and agency information.
exceptions: Cancel data selection if UserSession is null.
